hook: One clay tablet held a royal secret for 3,400 years.

sections.voiceover: One clay tablet held a royal secret for 3,400 years.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.

sections.voiceover: At Kayalipinar in central Turkey, archaeologists found 131 cuneiform tablets.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.

sections.voiceover: With 53 pieces recovered in 2025, the archive now totals 184.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.

sections.voiceover: One tablet records a deadly epidemic that decimated infants and young children.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.

sections.voiceover: A nursing princess was among them.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.
